name: v1.1.14 Round-2 Fixes: Sweep Ordering, Bounced Probe, Reset Cap
goal: Stop the recovery sweep from handing the Brain messages it is answering or that arrived after the limit, stop a bounced [PING] from causing a restart at window expiry, cap the parsed reset window at 6 hours, and keep the sweep pending when its send fails.
